note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The Ulsan account explicitly identifies opposing Japanese and Russian cruiser forces. The armoured-cruiser family illustrates a component of each force; differing Russian and Japanese gun arrangements are not reconstructed. Numerical fleet strengths and losses remain unreviewed. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: the armoured-cruiser component of each reviewed fleet at Ulsan receives its documented equipment family. The ships differed in size, armour and gun arrangement; the miniature is not an exact Rurik, Rossia, Gromoboi or Japanese cruiser reconstruction. No fleet total or casualty ratio is inferred.
